title: Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on Support for Pyeongtaek-si, etc. Following the Relocation of United States Forces Korea Bases
title_original: 주한미군기지 이전에 따른 평택시 등의 지원 등에 관한 특별법 시행령

metadata.completion_statement: All supplied main text, Articles 1 through 27 including inserted articles and deletion notices, and all supplied addenda from Presidential Decree No. 18777 through No. 35948 have been fully translated into English. Consequential amendment instructions and omission notices are retained. Separate annex and form contents are excluded as instructed, with their references retained in the main text and addenda. The translation is MACHINE_TRANSLATION / UNREVIEWED.
